tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one brand hue. Primary button fill, active nav marker, focus ring, selected states. Pair fills with `on-primary`.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for anything painted `primary`. Takes `on-primary` text.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` and `primary-hover` fills. Flips to dark ink in the dark theme because the fill lightens.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Links and inline accents on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `primary-soft`.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground: info callouts, active sidebar link, selected rows. Text on it is `ink` or `primary-text`.

tokens.name: primary-bright
tokens.usage: Decorative brand blue for illustration, the cover and large marks. Never text, never a fill behind text.

tokens.name: primary-deep
tokens.usage: Deep accent. Large decorative blocks and hero accents only; inverts to a pale periwinkle in dark so it never sinks into the ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. The dark value is the same colour as the light ink.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Sidebar, cards, the header bar. One step off `surface`; separate with `border`, not shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inline code chips, table header rows, the search field at rest.

tokens.name: code-surface
tokens.usage: Code block ground: light in the light theme, dark in the dark theme. Text on it is `code-ink`, `code-muted` or a `syntax-*` token.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Default code text on `code-surface`.

tokens.name: code-muted
tokens.usage: Comments, line numbers and the filename tab on `code-surface`.

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: PHP/JS keywords and Blade directives on `code-surface`.

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: Strings on `code-surface`.

tokens.name: syntax-attribute
tokens.usage: HTML attributes and `wire:` directives on `code-surface`.

tokens.name: syntax-variable
tokens.usage: Variables and properties (`$title`) on `code-surface`.

tokens.name: code-highlight
tokens.usage: Background of highlighted lines in a `CodeBlock`, on `code-surface`, with a 2px `syntax-keyword` edge.

tokens.name: code-added
tokens.usage: Background of added lines in a diff `CodeBlock`, on `code-surface`. Always with a `+` marker in `code-added-ink`.

tokens.name: code-added-ink
tokens.usage: The `+` marker on added diff lines, on `code-surface`.

tokens.name: code-removed
tokens.usage: Background of removed lines in a diff `CodeBlock`, on `code-surface`. Always with a `-` marker in `code-removed-ink`.

tokens.name: code-removed-ink
tokens.usage: The `-` marker on removed diff lines, on `code-surface`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, card and code-block edges, sidebar rule. Decorative, not a control boundary.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button outlines. Meets 3:1 on `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `primary-soft` and every `*-soft` ground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, sidebar links at rest, captions, on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, chevrons, decorative icons and timestamps on `surface` and `surface-raised`. Not on `surface-sunken`: use `ink-muted` there.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Tip callouts, saved/valid states: icon, border and short text on `surface` or `success-soft`. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tip callout ground. Body text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning callouts: icon, border and label on `surface` or `warning-soft`.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning callout ground. Body text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Validation errors and destructive buttons: text and borders on `surface` or `danger-soft`. Always with a message, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error banner ground. Body text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the search dialog and the mobile nav drawer.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home hero headline only, one per page.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings inside a page; these feed the on-this-page index.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Build dynamic UI components without leaving PHP.
styles.usage: The intro paragraph under an h1 or the hero, in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Phem renders the component on the server and runs its events.
styles.usage: Docs prose. The generous 28px leading is deliberate: pages are long and code-heavy.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Sidebar links, buttons, form labels, table cells.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Sidebar group titles and kicker labels, set in capitals in the markup.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Inline code in prose, on a `surface-sunken` chip.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, gap between stacked sidebar links.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and button horizontal padding, callout icon gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Callout and code-block padding, card gutters.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Code block horizontal padding, field-to-field gap in forms.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between paragraphs and blocks in prose; page side gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above an h2; sidebar group spacing.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing on marketing pages.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code chips, badges, sidebar link highlight.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Code blocks, callouts, cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Feature panels and the hero code window.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pill badges and avatar-style discs.

shadow.note: Shadows are rare: surfaces separate by `border` first. Use a shadow only for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons with an outline, the search field.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: The hero code window, the search dialog, menus.

layout.note: Fixed measures of the docs page frame.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Height of the sticky `Header`; also the scroll offset for anchored headings and the sticky top of the sidebar and table of contents.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Width of the `SidebarNav` column.

tokens.name: toc-width
tokens.usage: Width of the `TableOfContents` column.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Max width of the `Prose` column (about 72 characters of `body`).

tokens.name: page-width
tokens.usage: Max width of the header, footer and home-page sections.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: The sticky `Header` and `Banner`.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: The `MobileNav` drawer.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: The `SearchDialog` and the skip link.
